title: Fictional Household Support Grant
disclaimer: This policy, grant, currency, and applicants are fictional and for a controlled demonstration only. No payments are made. A staff member makes the final decision.

fields.name: residency
fields.label: Resident of the fictional service area?

sections.P1: Applicants must reside in the fictional service area; residency is met when the applicant answers yes.
sections.P2: Monthly household income of 2000 fictional credits or less meets the fictional income rule.
sections.P3: Full name identifies the applicant. Household size and reason for assistance provide context; they do not automatically disqualify an applicant.
sections.P4: The assistant prepares a non-binding assessment. Staff make the final decision; this demonstration does not provide payments.

rules.description: Monthly household income must be no more than 2000 fictional credits.
